citation_or_record: Wong, Anita M.-Y. 2023. Understanding Development and Disorder in Cantonese Using Language Sample Analysis. Routledge.
locator: Chapter 4, printed p.50 / PDF p.60, Instrumental SVC section
verified_contribution: Classifies 呢個用嚟切嘢 as an instrumental SVC and states that the instrument may be omitted or moved to subject position with 用嚟.
role_in_issue_443: Direct support that omission is possible in an instrumental 用嚟 description and that overt resource position is variable.
limitation: Does not specify the discourse conditions, prosody, or whether bare 用嚟 VP is a full clause, fragment, or null-topic continuation.

citation_or_record: Cheung, Hung-nin Samuel. 2018. 緣自何來：早期粵語中「嚟」的來去踪跡. Current Research in Chinese Linguistics 97(1):17–39.
locator: PDF pp.3–4 / article pp.20–21, section 5 and footnote 9
verified_contribution: Describes V1 + 嚟 + V2 as purposive and states that 用來／用嚟 has become a disyllabic expression.
role_in_issue_443: Supports treating 用嚟 VP as a conventionalized purpose/function sequence rather than freely reconstructing ordinary motion syntax.
limitation: Does not address subjectless fragments, null topics, or antecedent requirements.

citation_or_record: Matthews, Stephen, and Virginia Yip. 2011. Cantonese: A Comprehensive Grammar, 2nd ed.; official multimedia chapter 4.
verified_contribution: Provides object topicalization, hanging topics, secondary topicalization, and topic-chain examples with later unexpressed arguments.
role_in_issue_443: Primary Cantonese support for testing null-topic and discourse-chain analyses.
limitation: Does not analyze the exact 用嚟 VP surface or identify whether the missing role is subject, topic, or resource.

citation_or_record: Matthews, Stephen, and Virginia Yip. 2011. Cantonese: A Comprehensive Grammar, 2nd ed.; official multimedia chapter 5.
verified_contribution: Treats omitted pronouns as a Cantonese grammatical phenomenon.
role_in_issue_443: Supports context-sensitive argument omission as a live mechanism.
limitation: The displayed example is not the exact 用嚟 fragment and does not establish antecedentless licensing.

citation_or_record: Lee, Patrick Chi-Wai. 2018. A Study of Anaphoric Non-specific Object Drop in Cantonese: Classification and Derivation. Current Research in Chinese Linguistics 97(1):245–257.
verified_contribution: Distinguishes specific object drop from non-specific existential, generic, and attributive object drop and argues for antecedent-linked NP ellipsis.
role_in_issue_443: Supplies Cantonese evidence that omitted nominal material can have several discourse-linked interpretations.
limitation: Targets object drop, not the exact missing element or fragment status of subjectless 用嚟 VP.

citation_or_record: Huang, C.-T. James, and Barry C.-Y. Yang. 2024. Topic drop and pro drop. Language and Linguistics 25(1):1–27.
verified_contribution: Distinguishes topic drop from broader pro-drop and argues that Chinese-type null topics show root/CP-edge and locality restrictions, with last-resort qualifications.
role_in_issue_443: Defines diagnostics for a null-topic analysis and warns against treating all missing arguments alike.
limitation: General Chinese evidence; an embedded 用嚟 judgment may instead involve pro, argument ellipsis, or another analysis and therefore cannot alone confirm or refute null-topic structure.

citation_or_record: Merchant, Jason. 2004. Fragments and Ellipsis. Linguistics and Philosophy 27(6):661–738.
locator: DOI 10.1007/s10988-005-7378-3; author-uploaded full text and publisher metadata
verified_contribution: Argues that many short answers and other XP fragments have sentential syntax under movement plus ellipsis, using connectivity and island evidence.
role_in_issue_443: Provides one general analysis against which a question-linked 用嚟 response can be tested.
limitation: Cross-linguistic theory, not Cantonese-specific; the predicate-like 用嚟 VP target is not automatically one of the XP fragments analyzed there.

citation_or_record: Wei, Ting-Chi. 2016. Fragment answers in Mandarin Chinese. International Journal of Chinese Linguistics 3(1):100–131.
locator: DOI 10.1075/ijchl.3.1.04wei; author-uploaded full text, introduction, note 1, and conclusion
verified_contribution: Proposes movement plus TP ellipsis for Mandarin wh-answer fragments and a base-generated pro-copula-fragment analysis for yes/no answers and corrections; explicitly excludes verb-only short answers from the paper's analysis.
role_in_issue_443: Shows that question type can correlate with different fragment derivations while supplying a direct negative boundary against automatic transfer to predicate-like 用嚟 VP responses.
limitation: Mandarin, not Cantonese; the target is a verbal/predicate-like response of the type explicitly set aside, so the proposed derivations remain diagnostics rather than adopted analyses.

citation_or_record: Xu, Bo Robert, and Peggy Pik-Ki Mok. 2011. Final rising and global raising in Cantonese intonation. Proceedings of ICPhS XVII:2173–2176.
locator: Official ICPhS proceedings / author full text; experiments 1–2 and conclusion
verified_contribution: Finds that final rising is a strong localized cue for Cantonese questions, while global F0 raising was not reliably supported in the tested materials.
role_in_issue_443: Supports recording boundary position and acoustic cues rather than treating written punctuation as sufficient prosodic evidence.
limitation: Studies questions, not fragments or 用嚟; it does not define a fragment contour or prove that prosody distinguishes ellipsis from null-topic structure.
